caption: The drawing depicts a metallic door knocker in the shape of a hand. The hand is painted in shades of gold and bronze, with subtle highlights and shadows to suggest a three-dimensional appearance. The wrist of the hand is adorned with a decorative cuff resembling a ruffled sleeve, also rendered in gold tones. The hand is grasping a small spherical object, which is attached to a rectangular mounting plate below. There is another decorative square mounting plate at the wrist, featuring an ornate border pattern. Both plates are depicted with four screws, one in each corner, and are shaded with brown and ochre hues to enhance the metallic look. The overall background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery included.
title: Door Knocker
